WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT bats,
       appearance_count,
       appearance_count * 1.0 / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       appearance_count * 1.0 / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM hand_counts;
